gloss: mailing address; destination address (for shipping or forwarding)

definitions.gloss: mailing address; shipping address; recipient's address
definitions.explanation: The address to which documents, parcels, or other materials are to be sent. Standard term on shipping labels, order forms, and business correspondence.

examples.japanese: {送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧。
{送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up entering the wrong mailing address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送付先|そうふさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下記|かき}→下記：11376_kaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおりです。
examples.english: The address for sending the documents is as follows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{請求先|せいきゅうさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At the time of ordering, you can specify a shipping address separate from the billing address.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{送付|そうふ}→送付：07345_soufu⟧ ('sending; dispatch') and the suffix ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ ('destination; recipient'). The ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ suffix is highly productive and forms 'destination/target' nouns: ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ ('contact address'), {請求先|せいきゅうさき} ('billing address'), ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧ ('business partner'), ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧ ('place of employment').

USAGE:
Appears on shipping and order forms, in business letters, and in email signatures. In e-commerce it typically refers to the physical shipping address; in business correspondence it may refer to the address to which documents should be mailed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to enter the mailing address
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to specify the mailing address
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the mailing address
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to get the mailing address wrong
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: the mailing address (line)
- {送付先|そうふさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation of the mailing address

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧: addressee; destination — for any kind of communication, including email
- ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: address — the address itself, not specifically a destination
- {配送先|はいそうさき}: delivery address — specifically for physical delivery, common in e-commerce
- {請求先|せいきゅうさき}: billing address — contrasted with {送付先|そうふさき} on order forms
- {届|とど}け{先|さき}: delivery destination — more conversational
